decisions.decision: Reuse PC5 for server-side permission/security-control decisions; SO6 operational approvals never grant authorization.
Task assignees and operational approvers reference SO5 Resource public identity without duplicating resource or Party identity.

decisions.authority: legacy domain status fields and assigned-actor snapshots
decisions.decision: Existing order/procurement/resource lifecycle facts remain source-domain truth and may map prospectively to SO6 subject references without bulk conversion.

decisions.authority: source references, reasons and evidence identifiers
decisions.decision: SO6 stores bounded references only; SO7 later owns files/documents and source modules retain their canonical records.

decisions.authority: existing PC5 security approvals and domain histories
decisions.decision: Historical security approvals and source-domain histories remain unchanged; SO6 does not reinterpret them as operational approval decisions.
Source-specific writers retire only after controlled SO6 mapping and R6/owner acceptance.
